review:
Le Fisherman sends Smokey ice fishing. Winning positions become Golden Squares, and when a Rainbow symbol is present those squares reveal coins, green or gold clovers, buckets or global buckets. Buckets collect from a 3x3 area around them, while global buckets collect from the whole grid.

Epic Rainbows go further, revealing special symbols on every position. The On Thin Ice bonus keeps Golden Squares lit until they're activated, so they build up through the round. It's the fishing branch of the Le family, with a 15,000x ceiling and plenty of collect-style action.
